groups.name: spring.python.file
groups.description: Configuration properties for managing Python files.

groups.name: spring.python.pip
groups.description: Configuration group for Python package management using pip.

groups.name: spring.python.pip.library
groups.description: Configuration group for Python library installation and uninstallation using pip.

groups.name: spring.python.environment
groups.description: Configuration properties for managing Python virtual environments.

properties.name: spring.python.file.path
properties.description: Base directory path where Python scripts are stored or loaded from.

properties.name: spring.python.file.charset
properties.description: Charset used to read Python script files.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.command
properties.description: Command used to invoke pip for managing Python packages.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.redirect-error-stream
properties.description: Whether to redirect error stream when executing pip commands.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.redirect-output-stream
properties.description: Whether to redirect output stream when executing pip commands.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.read-output
properties.description: Whether to read the output of pip commands.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.library.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables automatic Python library management on Spring application lifecycle. When true, the system can preinstall or uninstall required packages.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.library.installed
properties.description: List of Python libraries to install before executing any Python scripts. Each entry defines a PythonLibraryManagement object.

properties.name: spring.python.pip.library.uninstalled
properties.description: List of Python libraries to uninstall before whole application shutdown. Each entry defines a PythonLibraryManagement object.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable creating a virtual environment.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.global-python-executable
properties.description: Global Python executable used to create virtual environments.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.backup-python-executable
properties.description: Backup Python executable to use when a virtual environment is not available.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.on-existing
properties.description: Strategy for handling existing virtual environments. Options: SKIP, REMOVE, FAIL.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.parent-directory
properties.description: Parent directory where virtual environments are created.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.redirect-error-stream
properties.description: Whether to redirect error stream when executing virtual environment commands.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.redirect-output-stream
properties.description: Whether to redirect output stream when executing virtual environment commands.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.read-output
properties.description: Whether to read the output of virtual environment commands.

properties.name: spring.python.environment.timeout
properties.description: Timeout for executing virtual environment commands.

values.description: Skip creation if virtual environment already exists.
Remove existing virtual environment and create a new one.
Fail if virtual environment already exists.
